metadata.explanation: Getter reads slide 0 background fill type from 186_3.pptx. Metric returns 1.0 if fill_type == 'SOLID'. Initial file has fill_type 'BACKGROUND' so negative control returns 0.0. [Fixed: renamed function suffixes from short 'dc7fd876' to full 32-char MD5 '7f279c8dbe68c5780c5b5f60310b951b' computed from '8979838c-54a5-4454-a2b8-3d135a1a5c8f|2']
fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced invalid 8-char suffix 'dc7fd876' with correct 32-char MD5 hash '7f279c8dbe68c5780c5b5f60310b951b' in getter function name 'get_pptx_bg_fill_type', metric function name 'check_pptx_bg_solid', evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads slide 0 background fill type from the saved PPTX file using python-pptx, returning fill.type.name which yields 'SOLID' for any solid color fill.
Metric correctly compares fill_type to 'SOLID', which is the exact python-pptx PP_FILL enum name for solid color fills.
Negative control is sound: the initial file has fill_type 'BACKGROUND' (master/theme), so an untouched file returns 0.0.
The 'any color acceptable' requirement is correctly handled by checking fill type only, not the specific color value.
Error handling covers both missing file and missing python-pptx import, preventing false positives.
Evaluates only the one relevant requirement (solid fill on slide 0), with no over-specification.
